_doc: Retrato de novela visual para los diálogos (src/data/characters.js): de medio cuerpo para arriba, mirando al frente, sobre blanco para recortarlo. Se entrega a img/characters/<id>-profile.png y de ahí a img/portraits/<id>.webp. Referencias: los retratos que ya tiene el juego, para que todos parezcan del mismo pincel.
subject: a visual novel dialogue portrait of {name}, a character from a medieval fantasy village{details}
pose: standing, facing the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn, arms relaxed, neutral expression with a hint of personality, framed from the head down to mid-thigh
mandatory: Framed from the top of the head down to mid-thigh; the head is fully visible with a small empty margin above it.
The lower edge of the image cuts the legs at mid-thigh, straight across.
Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), perfectly uniform.
No scenery, no ground, no cast shadow, no extra objects or characters.
